newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent weakens on API, March tests $21.00.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent weakens on API, March tests $21.00.

text.p: Brent March crude was lower in later afternoon dealings in Asia and testing support at $21.00 per barrel.
March last traded on SIMEX at $21.00, an intraday low and down 14 cents from London's overnight settlement after a bearish set of API data.
"The APIs are not doing any favours to the market," one broker said.

The API said after the close of NYMEX trading that crude stocks rose last week 3.64 million barrels, against expectations for a 2.0-million build. Refinery runs fell to 87.6 percent of capacity from 90.3 percent.
It also reported a larger-than-expected draw in distillate stocks of 4.92 million barrels.

Brokers said the crude and refinery data undermined the crude and although the distillate data offered initial support to heating oil it gave way later as market focus is shifting to the upcoming U.S. gasoline season.
